verses.t: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he
verses.pickthall: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish

verses.t: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained
verses.pickthall: His wealth and gains will not exempt him

verses.t: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
verses.pickthall: He will be plunged in flaming Fire

verses.t: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood
Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber
verses.pickthall: Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre
